constraints: Passing the optional '*' parameter marks the response as chunked (adds 'transfer-encoding: chunked' to the header if necessary); all subsequent WEB SEND RAW DATA calls in the same method become additional chunks of that same response until the method finishes executing.
data must contain both the HTTP header and body parts of the response; 4D performs a basic validity check and will complete/fix an incomplete header or request before sending.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Chunked raw response: WEB SEND RAW DATA (data; *) starts a chunked response with a header -> subsequent WEB SEND RAW DATA calls in the same method (with or without '*') are treated as additional body chunks of that response -> the server ends the chunked send when the method terminates.
